title: Cost to Get Sports Cards Graded (2026)
verdict: The cost to get sports cards graded in 2026 is $18 a card at AGS, $10 to $30 at CGC depending on card value, and $24.99 and up at PSA.

For comparison, CGC's bulk tier is $10 a card with a 10-card minimum, Beckett's Base tier is $14.95, ISA charges a flat $15, PSA's open value tiers run $24.99 to $79.99, and SGC's base price was reported at $50 in September 2026. Prices moved several times this year, so confirm before you ship.

why: The price does not move with the card. AGS charges $18 per card whatever it is worth, with bulk tiers from $15 at 30 cards. PSA and SGC price by declared value and CGC caps each tier by card value, so a card that turns out to be worth more can cost more to grade.

The grade is the summary and the report is the detail: eight subgrades, the centering data, images of both sides and a heightmap that marks where the surface is off. It is yours to download, and a buyer can reach it from the cert number.

Standard turnaround is 20 business days or less. The faster bulk tiers come back in 10 business days at $20 and 5 at $30, and AGS says same-day grading is available for urgent submissions. A scan that takes under 10 seconds is what makes those numbers possible.

faq.q: What is the cost to get sports cards graded?
faq.a: Most entry tiers cost $10 to $50 a card in November 2026. AGS is $18 with subgrades and a report included.

faq.q: Is there a minimum number of cards?
faq.a: Not at AGS. You can send one card at $18, and bulk pricing needs 30. CGC's bulk tier needs 10 cards, ISA needs 10, and GMA needs 10 to 25 depending on the tier.

faq.q: Which card grader has the lowest listed price?
faq.a: As of November 18, 2026, GMA is lowest at $12 a card with a 25-card minimum, or $9 at 100 cards. CGC's bulk tier is $10 with a 10-card minimum on cards worth up to $500. Beckett's Base tier is $14.95, and ISA and AGS bulk are $15.

faq.q: Is it worth grading a low-value card?
faq.a: Only if grading lifts the price by more than the fee plus shipping, or if you want the card protected and documented. At $10 to $18 a card the math works on far more cards than at $50.

faq.q: What costs come on top of the grading fee?
faq.a: Shipping to the grader, return shipping and insurance, and supplies such as penny sleeves and card savers. Some graders add membership fees, subgrade fees or value upcharges. AGS adds return shipping at checkout.
